title: Government Forces Advance in Western Taiz After Repelling Houthi Offensive
detail: Yemeni government forces retook positions and advanced in western Taiz on September 13-14, 2026 after repelling a Houthi offensive, backed by airstrikes on Houthi gatherings in coastal areas including Mocha and Dhubab. Fighting since September 1 has displaced nearly 86,000 people, with more than 2,000 crossing into neighboring Djibouti. The advance came as Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree claimed the group had fired 'dozens of ballistic missiles and drones' at King Khalid airbase in Khamis Mushait, targeting hangars, radar installations, runways and ammunition depots, and describing it as retaliation for a claimed 300+ Saudi airstrikes across Yemen in five days.
